name: DREAM HOTLINE
source:
The Dream Hotline is a customer calling service that connects users with a professional, allowing them to discuss their dreams. Whether they be funny, scary, or downright odd.

Sometimes... Some bizarre individuals call our line.

[From [url=https://tokipetal.itch.io/dream-hotline]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
梦想热线是一项客户呼叫服务，可将用户与专业人士联系起来，让他们讨论自己的梦想。无论它们是有趣的、可怕的还是完全奇怪的。

有时…一些奇怪的人拨打我们的电话。

[来自[url=https://tokipetal.itch.io/dream-hotline]itch.io[/url]]
